gaps.cause: missing fund column; missing lines (nonoperating receipts recorded as revenue)
gaps.explanation: Statement p4 (Governmental Funds, modified cash) Total Receipts 346,152.45 = General 221,966.11 + Street 98,457.05 + Keno 25,729.29. Detail revenue (501,291) = General Fund departments schedule p10 receipts (printed total 221,966) + the schedule's NONOPERATING RECEIPTS (p11: TIF receipts (101,122) + 311,431, Donations 61,475 + 508 + 1,219, Interest income 3,919 + 69 + 1,774 + 13 + 40 = 279,326; detail 18-27). (1) Missing fund columns: Street and Keno print receipts only on the statement (the p9 budget schedule prints revenues for all funds combined): Street Property taxes 21,829.47, Motor vehicle 2,229.60, Other (taxes) 1,855.65, Intergovernmental 72,542.33 = 98,457.05; Keno proceeds 25,729.29; added = 124,186.34. (2) The statement prints TIF receipts 210,309.32, Donations 63,202.00 and Interest income 6,760.93 under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES), not in Total Receipts; the 10 detail lines are moved to section other financing (removed and re-added with the same fund/department/amount), plus the Keno column's Interest income 945.92 (p4 other financing) which no detail line had. Check: 501,291 + 124,186.34 - 279,326 = 346,151.34 vs 346,152.45 (1.11 = whole-dollar rounding).

gaps.cause: missing lines (interest expense recorded as expenditure)
gaps.explanation: Statement p4 Total Disbursements 581,657.48 = General 488,532.17 + Street 60,322.23 + Keno 32,803.08. Detail expenditure 769,684 = departments schedule pp10-11 (printed Total Disbursements 676,557) + budget schedule p9 Streets 60,322 + Keno 32,803. The departments schedule counts Debt Service Interest 188,025 (TIF Projects, p11; detail 66) inside Total Disbursements, while the statement prints it as 'Interest expense (188,024.88)' under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES) (General column 488,532.17 = 676,557 - 188,025). Fix: move detail 66 to section other financing (removed, re-added as -188,025). Check: 769,684 - 188,025 = 581,659 vs 581,657.48 (1.52 rounding).
